title: RGB mixer
author: Matt Venn
about: The Zero to ASIC course's demo: debounced rotary encoders driving three PWM outputs, hardened as a Caravel user project.

title: Op-amp
author: Efabless
about: A simple operational amplifier drawn in Magic, Efabless's example of an analog IP block characterized with CACE.

title: 500 kHz RC oscillator
author: Tim Edwards, Efabless
about: A low-power, current-starved ring oscillator with an enable, slowed down by capacitors rather than a huge bias resistor.

title: GPIO pad
author: SkyWater Technology
about: SkyWater's general-purpose I/O pad cell, from the sky130 I/O cell library.

title: MCS-4 4004 CPU
author: Munetomo Maruyama
about: Intel's 4004, the CPU of the first microcomputer set, rebuilt from scratch in Verilog - on Tiny Tapeout SKY25a.

title: Oscillating Bones
author: Uri Shaked
about: A ring oscillator made of a chain of 21 SkullFET inverters - on Tiny Tapeout 09.

title: 12-bit SAR ADC
author: Ricardo Nunes
about: A successive-approximation ADC whose capacitor DAC is built from metal1-to-metal2 capacitors of about 0.8 fF each - on Tiny Tapeout 07.

title: SkullFET
author: Uri Shaked
about: Hand-crafted, skull-shaped transistors, built into a NOT gate, a NAND gate and an SR flip-flop - on Tiny Tapeout 05.

title: 555 timer
author: Vincent Fusco
about: A clone of the classic 555 timer, as an analog design - on Tiny Tapeout 06.

title: VGA clock
author: Matt Venn
about: A clock drawn on a VGA screen by racing the beam, with its font held in registers - on Tiny Tapeout 08.
